body.name: \((V_\theta,V_\tau)\)
body.construction: For \(p\geq3\), the fixed ordered embedding \(\iota\), and \(J=J_{\boldsymbol d,\mathcal T}(\theta)\), define \(V_\theta(\boldsymbol d,\theta)=(J^{\mathsf T}WJ)^{-1}J^{\mathsf T}W\Sigma_gWJ(J^{\mathsf T}WJ)^{-1}\) and \(V_\tau(\boldsymbol d,\theta;\iota)=C_\tau(\boldsymbol d,\theta;\iota)V_\theta(\boldsymbol d,\theta)C_\tau(\boldsymbol d,\theta;\iota)^{\mathsf T}\).
